name: kotobase
description: npm dependencies of the ClojureScript half. kotobase.core reaches kotoba-lang/security, whose cljs branch requires @noble/hashes; without it `nbb` cannot load kotobase.core at all, which is a claim this repo's own README makes.

scripts.test:causal-worker: clojure -M:cljs-test -m cljs.main -co '{:target :nodejs :output-to "target/p2-tests.js" :output-dir "target/p2-out" :optimizations :none :main kotobase.async-test-runner}' -c kotobase.async-test-runner && node target/p2-tests.js
